name: SVC_STD_TXT_USR_VARS
description: This table stores the available variables defined by the customer and its static values or object.attribute substitution

columns.name: VARIABLE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: VARIABLE_NUMBER
columns.description: VARIABLE_NUMBER. This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: VARIABLE_UNIQUE_NUMBER
columns.description: VARIABLE_UNIQUE_NUMBER. This is a public unique and required surrogate key.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: Variable that is displayed in the UI for context substitution into actual value.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Short Description of the variable and its context.

columns.name: CONTEXT
columns.description: Indicator of the application or context this variable is used.

columns.name: DATACONTROL
columns.description: This is the reference to the datacontrol that the object belongs to

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: This is the reference to the object that holds the value for substituting the variable.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: This is the field or attribute on the object that holds the value for substitution

columns.name: VAL_CHAR
columns.description: Static character value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_DATE
columns.description: Static date value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Static timestamp value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Static number value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the SmartText User Variable.
